_note: Freeze every value in this file BEFORE a held-out evaluation or a hybrid trial session. Changing one after seeing results = dated logbook entry + new session.

pink._note_nopink: NO-PINK VERSION: pink is not measured or removed, and `pink` does not need to be run. The tool is found by comparing each slot with the empty-board photo (board.tool_only), so the shadow is greyed out anyway.
pink._note: Pink pixels (the paper shadows) are painted neutral grey before the model sees a crop, so it cannot learn the shadow outline instead of the tool. Run `python ai_main.py pink` to measure YOUR pink from refs/<current>/empty.png; these defaults are only used until then.

board._note: What the model sees of each slot. footprint: keep only the slot's own pink shadow (from refs/<dir>/empty.png of that session) grown by grow_px; the floor and neighbouring tools are painted grey. exposure: scale each colour channel so the bare paper between slots has median `target` (evens out exposure -6 vs -4 and white-balance drift). Run `pink` BEFORE import-trials.

tool_only._note2: empty_share: a slot whose changed area is under this share of its box is EMPTY by rule (confidence 1.0), the model is not asked. max_ref_mismatch: hybrid warns at the first checkout when more than this share of the bare paper no longer matches the empty-board photo (retake capture-refs).
tool_only._note: The model sees ONLY the tool: pixels that differ from the same slot on the empty-board photo, inside the slot's footprint, placed in a same-size grey window centred on the tool. No pink, no shadow outline, no slot shape, so it cannot tell which slot it is looking at. window_px null = 1.15 x the largest slot side.

training._note: exclude_swap_crops: a tool sitting in ANOTHER tool's slot (pink shows around it) is left out of TRAINING; it stays in the held-out evaluation, which is the honest swap test. skip_suspects: crops whose label disagrees with the photo (see dataset/<session>/suspects.png) are left out of training AND evaluation, and counted. Add any other bad crop to config/ai_bad_crops.txt (one crop path per line, e.g. tc-20261112-212119/crops/t005_signoff_03.png).

augment._note: Extra training copies per crop with random lighting (brightness, colour temperature, a soft shadow) and small placement changes. Training sessions only; never applied to evaluation crops.

decision._note: Confidence limits for the hybrid. Pick them from the validation numbers train prints, BEFORE evaluating on the held-out session.
decision._note_v3: v3 (2026-11-19, after hybrid session hybrid-20261118-232906): a slot Method A flagged on COLOUR only (shape score under its frozen limit) is cleared when the AI names its own tool at >= colour_only_clear_confidence. Look-alike slots still need clear_confidence.

_note_absent_tools: Tools NOT in the kit this session (e.g. left at school). Their slot stays EMPTY: never used in a removal or swap, expected empty at checkout and sign-off, and flagged if anything is put in it. The model keeps all 12 classes (trained on sessions 1-3). Hybrid session only; replay of old sessions ignores it. Set back to [] when the tool is back.

plan._note: true = the complete-kit trials go through EVERY perturbation in the kit file (lift, nudge, rotate, hand shadow, second lamp, no change) before repeating one, in a shuffled order. false = toolcheck's random pick per trial (the hand shadow never came up in hybrid-20261118-232906).

lighting_override._note: Retake check says the light changed, but the model names every slot's own tool with at least this confidence: accept the photo instead of asking for a retake. mode all_own = only when the kit looks complete (your trial 27 idea); all_confident = also when the model confidently names a missing or wrong tool.
lighting_override._note_v3: v3 (2026-11-19): mode shape_ok = the light changed, Method A's SHAPE score is under its limit in every slot, and the AI's top answer is the own tool in every slot at >= confidence. In session hybrid-20261118-232906 Measuring tape / Wire stripper / Box cutter never reached 0.90 even in normal light, so all_own at 0.90 could never fire.

retake._note: max_retakes null = use toolcheck's settings.json value. skip_many_slot_retake_if_ai_confident: 3+ flagged slots with NO lighting change and every flagged slot confidently named = report them, no retake (your trial 14 note).

checkout_check._note: Classify every checkout photo; if a slot does not hold its own tool, stop before the trial (catches a previous swap not undone, as in session 3 trials 14 and 16).

test_mode._note: TESTS ONLY. true adds 'f = force-accept this photo' at every retake prompt. Forced trials are marked forced=1 and reported separately. Never enable for watch-serve or a real sign-off.
